name: Lucifer the Magic Master
source:
A cursed mage who appears in the town of Noche only at night. He looks like a boy about 10 years old, his actual age is unknown.

[Translated from the game's [url=https://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/ps2/angelicconcert/src/angelic_charaframe.htm]Official Homepage[/url].]
